Lessons.Title: How Much is 10,000?
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will develop a relative sense of ten-thousand and understand it as a unit consisting of 10 units of one-thousand.
In this lesson, you build on your understanding of the base-ten structure to develop a sense of the magnitude of 10,000. You first use base-ten blocks and base-ten diagrams to build four-digit and five-digit numbers. You then use a 10-by-10 grid to represent 100 and work together to build a representation of 1,000, and then 10,000.
Core relationship: Ten thousand as ten groups of one thousand. Build quantities from 10 equal 1,000-unit groups; distinguish 100, 1,000 and 10,000.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  What Do You Know about 1,000?	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Build Numbers	 (15 minutes); Activity 2:  What is 10,000?	 (20 minutes); Cool-down:  Represent Numbers	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: How many thousands make 10,000?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): How many 1,000-blocks represent 20,000?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
